egress.terms: HARD METERED, and worse for programmatic use. Verbatim from help centre: base quotas are 'Cloud Download: 40 TB per month. Downstream: 4 TB per month, including playback, previews, and downloads. Upload: 1 TB per month.' And 'Connected Apps share a combined transfer quota limit equal to 25% of your monthly Transfer Quota, across all three traffic dimensions.' So rclone/WebDAV/CLI. The only programmatic paths. Get 25% of 4 TB = 1 TB/month downstream.

extras.price_verbatim: $0.833/TB/mo at 10 TB ($99.99/yr Global Premium). Looks like the cheapest per-TB number in this dossier — and it is a trap. Usable programmatic egress is 1 TB/month (25% × 4 TB downstream). Effective cost per TB actually retrievable per month is fine, but the ceiling makes it unusable for serving or bulk restore. Reject on egress, not on price.
extras.agent_focus: Cheap-PAID lane: revisit DEAD-ENDS.md and paid-rejected dossier verdicts (fails-quota / trial-only with a price) to recompute $/TB/month at 5 TB and 20 TB tiers. Egress policy is the deciding term. Excludes AWS/Azure/GCP/Alibaba/R2/B2/IDrive e2 per client.
